# dsh-tts-service
English | 简体中文

Multi-provider text-to-speech (TTS) service for DSH: Doubao TTS 2.0,
Alibaba Bailian and OpenAI-comp

atible providers register independently and the user picks the voice; the agent can
speak with per-s
egment tone, and other plugins reuse the same service.
One package, several plugin entries that you switch on and off separately on the DSH plugin page:
| Entry id | What it does | On by default |
| `tts-service` | The service `ctx.ttsService`: provider registry, selection (provider, voice per pr

ovider, language), synthesis, voice listing. | yes |
| `tts-doubao` | Provider: Doubao (Volcengine)

TTS 2.0. | **no** |
| `tts-bailian` | Provider: Alibaba Bailian / Model Studio (CosyVoice, Qwen-Audi

o-TTS, Qwen3-TTS). | **no** |
| `tts-openai-compatible` | Provider: any endpoint compatible with `PO

ST /audio/speech`. | **no** |
| `tts-say` | Agent tools `tts_service_say`, `tts_service_voices` and

`tts_service_select`, plus the output registry `ctx.ttsSay`. | yes |
| `tts-speaker-windows` | Outpu
t: play on the PC speakers when you are at the computer (Windows only; registers nothing elsewhere).
on the PC speakers when you are at the computer (Windows only; registers nothing elsewhere). | yes |
There is **no default provider and no default voice**. Until you pick one, `tts_service_say` fails w

ith
`VOICE_NOT_SELECTED` and tells the agent where to pick it.
This version synthesizes whole clips (no streaming).
## Requirements

- DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0-0` (prereleases included). Tests run against the 0.2.1-rc.5 packages.
- N

ode.js 22 or newer (the one that ships with DSH is fine).
- An account and API key for at least one

provider (see below). Synthesis is billed by the provider.
- For the speaker output: Windows with Wi
ndows PowerShell (`powershell.exe`, present by default).
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
or from GitHub: `dsh plugin add github:loveandbeepbrother/dsh-tts-service`.
## Quick start
1. On the plugin page, switch on **one provider entry** (`tts-doubao`, `tts-bailian` or `tts-openai-

compatible`) and
fill in its form.
2. Store its API key in DSH's credential store (see Keys).
3. Pic
k a voice: ask the agent "list the available voices" and then "use voice X", or set it yourself in t

he settings
of **Text-to-Speech Service** (`tts-service`): `provider` = the provider id (e.g. `douba

o`), and an entry in
`voices`: provider id → voice id. See Choosing a voice.
4. Ask the agent to say

entry in
`voices`: provider id → voice id. See Choosing a voice.
4. Ask the agent to say something.
## Keys
Configuration never contains secret values, only **key names**. The value comes from DSH's credentia

l service
(`ctx.credentials`, the key store on the settings page) or, when no credential service is

loaded, from the environment
DSH was launched with. Keys are read on every request, so a rotated key

applies immediately. The settings page shows
only whether a key is configured.
| Entry | Config field | Default key name | Used for |
| `tts-doubao` | `apiKeyEnv` | `VOLCENGINE_TTS_API_KEY` | Synthesis (an API key from the Volcengine

console, "API Key 管理"). |
| `tts-doubao` | `accessKeyEnv`, `secretKeyEnv` | `VOLCENGINE_ACCESS_KEY`,
`VOLCENGINE_SECRET_KEY` | Optional: your Volcengine account AK/SK, only to list the complete voice

catalogue. |
[该节后续省略]
### OpenAI-compatible endpoints (`tts-openai-compatible`, provider id `openai-compatible`)
No vendor, URL or voice is preset. Fill in:
| Field | Default | Notes |

| `name` | `OpenAI 兼容接口` | Display name. |
| `baseUrl` | required | e.g. `https://example.com/v1`; t

he plugin calls `{baseUrl}/audio/speech`. |
| `model` | required | |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `OPENAI_COMPATI

BLE_TTS_API_KEY` | Empty: no `Authorization` header. |
| `instructions` | `false` | Set to `true` if

the endpoint accepts the `instructions` parameter. |
| `voices` | `[]` | Hand-written voice table,
used when `GET {baseUrl}/audio/voices` is not available. Each entry can set `instructions: false`. |

| `languages` | `["auto"]` | Only used to validate the selected language; not sent. |
| `maxChars`
The plugin always requests `response_format: "wav"` and needs 16-bit PCM WAV back. To use two endpoi

nts, add a second
row to your profile with another `providerId`.
> This is **not** "the OpenAI integration". Note that OpenAI's own three speech models are scheduled

to be retired on
> 2027-01-06; check the vendor's current model list before pointing this entry at

be retired on
> 2027-01-06; check the vendor's current model list before pointing this entry at it.
## Known limitations
These can only be confirmed by real use; reports are welcome.
- Bailian `qwen3-tts-instruct-*`: where `instructions` goes in the HTTP body (`input.instructions`)

is inferred from the
official SDK example, not from the HTTP reference.
- Bailian without `workspace

Id`: whether the old DashScope domain still serves newer models after 2026-09-30 is not
confirmed. S

et `workspaceId` if a model is rejected.
- Per-request character limits are conservative guesses whe

re the docs give none: Doubao 300, Bailian
SpeechSynthesizer (CosyVoice, Qwen-Audio-TTS) 2000. Both

can be changed with `maxChars`.
- Doubao: the accepted `explicit_language` values (`zh-cn`, `en`, `j

a` are sent) and the format of the language field
in `ListSpeakers` responses are not confirmed.
- T
he static voice tables are transcribed from the official pages and may be incomplete or contain mist

akes, so
lists built from them (Doubao without AK/SK, all Bailian lists) are always marked incomplet

e and
`tts_service_select` accepts ids that are not in them. You can always type a voice id by hand.
## Privacy
The text, tone descriptions and context are sent to the provider you selected. Doubao requests go to
`openspeech.bytedance.com` (and `open.volcengineapi.com` for listing); Bailian requests go to your

region's DashScope
or workspace domain, and the audio is downloaded from the URL it returns; OpenAI-

compatible requests go to your
`baseUrl`. Nothing else leaves the machine unless an output sends the

ble requests go to your
`baseUrl`. Nothing else leaves the machine unless an output sends the audio.
